description: Watch an https URL of your live app with your uptime-watch (up to 3 URLs). We check it every 5 minutes; 2 failures in a row (or 3 of the last 5) open an incident: a message in the inbox you name and one email to your owner (once they confirmed their address). Recovery sends one "back up" message and email.

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your webhook inboxes, to be woken there when the URL goes down or comes back.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

url.description: Public https URL, at most 2048 characters, e.g. https://your-app.example.com/health

name: uptime_add
title: Watch a URL
